key_insight: Jet-RL introduces a unified FP8 precision flow that lets on-policy RL (including the expensive rollout phase) run in FP8 without losing model quality, cutting rollout compute and time substantially.
problem_solved: Rollouts dominate on-policy RL training time and resource use (>70%), and prior pipelines either keep expensive BF16 for rollouts or fail in stability when aggressively quantized.
method: Unified precision flow: apply FP8 consistently across rollout and training to remove precision mismatches and pipeline overheads.
Precision-aware algorithms: use quantization-aware forward/backward passes, adaptive loss/activation scaling, and selective higher-precision accumulation for numerically sensitive ops.
Integration with on-policy loop: coordinate rollout generation, advantage estimation, and optimizer updates under a single FP8 management strategy to preserve stability and accuracy.
impact: Enables large-scale, cost-effective on-policy RL for LLMs by reducing compute, memory, and wall-clock time for rollouts, allowing more experiments and faster fine-tuning with lower infrastructure cost.

paper_title: Jet-RL: Enabling On-Policy FP8 Reinforcement Learning with Unified Training and Rollout Precision Flow
paper_authors: Haocheng Xi, Charlie Ruan, Peiyuan Liao, Yujun Lin, Han Cai
